name: Ridgefield
_domain_note: Principal 2026-10-26 STUDIOS-SHOP-PATH DECIDED: shop at https://ridgefieldtech.com/shop (main-site rewrite to this project); store.ridgefieldtech.com 301s to the path; store@ and orders@ addresses unchanged.
description: Ridgefield store, capsule 01: apparel and a pack.
tagline: Systems that perform under real-world conditions.
_tagline_status: PROVISIONAL headline: Ridgefield's site line, used as the anchor until the Principal sets shop copy. Copy follows the Ridgefield voice docs: composed, minimal, no em dashes, no promotional language. Render taglines ('Built for higher ground', 'Apparel and gear for what's next', 'More than apparel') are not used.

logo._spec: The real Ridgefield mark from ridgefieldtech.com (~/ridgefield/frontend/index.html .mark): a solid square with a square cut-out, plus RIDGEFIELD in JetBrains Mono. The chevron mark in the AI renders is NOT Ridgefield's.

copy.exchangeLine: Size exchanges within 14 days of delivery.
copy.checkoutOff: Checkout opens when the shop opens.

shipping.note: US shipping at launch. Rate set per release.

policies.contact_status: placeholder: confirm the inbox before launch
policies.exchange_shipping: you pay to send the piece back; we pay to ship the new size to you
policies.preorder_cancel: yes, for a full refund. Email us with your order number
policies.returns: Size exchanges within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unworn with tags.
policies._note: Policy pages (privacy, terms, returns, shipping, policies hub) render from core/policies.mjs. Every [CONFIRM] value and every *_status placeholder blocks a live build.
policies._note_2026_10_18: Pre-launch defaults set by the storefront lane (returns 14 days, exchange shipping split, 7-year order records, pre-orders cancellable before the window closes). Still open before live: mailing_address + governing_law (JARVIS L1) and a working contact inbox (SETUP_TODO email-routing rows).

_orders: Order emails (core/email.mjs): the shop notification goes to orders_inbox; the customer confirmation comes from orders_from as from_name. PLACEHOLDER inboxes: confirm they exist (and verify the domain in Resend) before live checkout.

release_states._note: Labels and helper lines for release-managed items (catalog `release`: order | preorder | reserve | waitlist, optional reserve_limit). Off until a product carries `release`. Defaults: core/catalog.mjs RELEASE_COPY. {window} = the item's release.window, {limit} = its reserve_limit.

order.helper: In stock. The ship date shows at checkout.

preorder.helper: Paid now, made after the pre-order window closes. Ships {window}.

reserve.helper: Reserving holds your place. It isn't an order and you won't be charged.
reserve.terms: Places are kept in the order they arrive. When orders open, everyone who reserved gets a {priority_window} head start by email before the public.
reserve.done: Your place is held. We'll email you before orders open to everyone.

waitlist.helper: Join the waitlist to help us decide what to make. We will email you when this piece is available.
waitlist.done: You're on the waitlist. We'll email you when it's available to reserve or order.

footer._note: Mirrors the ridgefieldtech.com footer (live 2026-10-26): Solutions, Process, Company, Connect, with absolute links back to the main site; Shop = this shop's own pages. Principal 2026-10-26. Policy links + main-site link are appended by the core.
footer.note: Concept renders. Final pieces are confirmed with the maker before the pre-order opens.
